name: Rules & Approvals
summary: Rules & Approvals is the workspace policy: it allows, refuses or holds other apps’ calls, always with a recorded reason.

intents: set a rule for my agents
require approval before an agent sends or pays
explain why a call was refused

operations.title: Delete rule
operations.description: Remove a rule from evaluation. Its revision history stays.

operations.title: Restore a rule revision
operations.description: Make an earlier revision of a rule its current version, as a new revision. A deleted rule comes back. The revision passes the same checks as Save rule.

operations.title: Preview a decision
operations.description: Dry run: which rule would decide this call, and why. Optionally with an unsaved rule. The answer names the Fleet facts used (the caller's teams, the claimed requester's teams and trust) and whether they were available; when they are not, deny and hold rules that name them apply and allow rules that name them do not. For an app caller, pass its product (omit it to try a call whose product cannot be verified: deny and hold rules with callerProducts apply, allow rules with it do not).
